source_of_truth: scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/ command surfaces: cli.py, agent_brief.py, agent_surface.py, agent_manifest.py, command_validation.py, operator_console.py / ActionItem command model, and the completed onboarding-v0 + control-plane action spine plans.

user_journeys.name: new-agent-starts-correctly
user_journeys.description: An interactive agent installed after DontPanic runs `dontpanic --help`, sees the AI-agent entrypoint immediately, and starts with `dontpanic agent brief` / machine JSON instead of guessing workflow from flag docs.
acceptance_signals: root help includes the AI-agent start-here section
agent brief points to command guidance JSON
agent does not need repo-specific prior knowledge to find the safe flow

user_journeys.name: agent-lands-on-workflow-command
user_journeys.description: An agent that opens a specific command help page such as dispatch-from-plan, next, close, finalize, plan lock, or plan-review sees the command's role in the safe workflow and whether it is read-only, mutating, dispatching/paid, or human-gated.
acceptance_signals: workflow command help includes class-specific agent guidance
read-only commands tell agents they are safe to inspect before mutation
mutating/dispatching commands warn not to auto-run without an automatable ActionItem or explicit approval

user_journeys.name: agent-uses-json-not-help-scraping
user_journeys.description: An outer harness such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Grok CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, or a local model runner can request a stable JSON command guidance envelope and follow DontPanic's policy without scraping terminal help text.
acceptance_signals: JSON envelope covers all known top-level commands
entries include command class, audience, examples, and human escalation rule

user_journeys.name: agent-loads-versioned-guide
user_journeys.description: A harness that supports loadable skills/guides can locate or print a version-matched DontPanic guide that explains workflow patterns, command classes, dashboard handoff, and the operator/worker/orchestrator distinction.
acceptance_signals: guide artifact exists without network access
guide content is validated against the command inventory
root help and agent brief point to the guide/locator

non_goals: Same-plan worktree isolation or multi-writer undo.
Changing command behavior beyond help, guidance, and read-only metadata surfaces.
Replacing ActionItem or the control-plane action spine.
required_evidence: test_output: command inventory coverage against command_validation.known_subcommands
test_output: root help and representative workflow command help include agent guidance
test_output: machine JSON command-guidance envelope schema and coverage
test_output: packaged guide parity with command inventory
test_output: future-command coverage gate fails on missing guidance
completion_test: A fresh interactive agent can run `dontpanic --help`, discover the AI-agent entrypoint, inspect `dontpanic agent brief` and the command-guidance JSON, see agent-safe help for workflow commands, and locate a versioned DontPanic guide. Tests prove every known top-level command has guidance, workflow-critical commands carry class-specific safety text, and new commands cannot ship without adding guidance.
